title: LRU Coarse Cache -- zero-cost state returns (Ghost #41)
gate_source: EXP-605 Ghost #41: coarse content-addressed only vs immediate prev; returns re-send
operator: game.observability.stream (session LRU of H_coarse -> anchors; coarse_ref event)

mechanism.lru: bounded session cache H_coarse -> coarse frame (default 16); LRU eviction
mechanism.coarse_ref: a world returning to ANY cached coarse emits coarse_ref {H_coarse} (zero anchor payload)
mechanism.levels: (1) immediate skip if H_coarse unchanged, (2) coarse_ref if in LRU, (3) keyframe/delta otherwise
mechanism.eviction: return to an evicted coarse re-sends (keyframe) -> bounded memory, graceful

assertions_fork_A: [2] codec exact: decode(encode) reconstructs coarse field bit-exactly with LRU+refs
[3] zero-cost returns: loop A B A B A B -> 2 keyframes + 4 coarse_refs (returns not re-sent)
[5] bitrate: LRU coarse bytes < no-LRU coarse bytes on a loop
[6] reconstruction parity: LRU field == no-LRU field (same result, fewer bytes)
[7] LRU eviction bounded: lru_size respected; return beyond window re-sends keyframe
[8] backward-compat: a non-looping stream emits no coarse_ref (EXP-605 behavior preserved)
[10] decoupled: game/ has no engine.* import (clean-room guard)
assertions_fork_B: [2] event-type counts fwd == mir on a loop stream
